rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something lazily or in a languid, listless way.

example.english: They indolently lounge on the sofa watching television.
example.traditional: 佢成日懶洋洋咁攤喺梳化度睇電視。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laan5 joeng4 joeng4 gam3 taan1 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this when the person is idling along leisurely rather than making an effort.

example.english: I indolently spent the whole day at home on my day off.
example.traditional: 我放假嗰日懶懶閒咁喺屋企過咗成日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 go2 jat6 laan5 laan5 haan4 gam3 hai2 uk1 kei2 gwo3 zo2 seng4 jat6

rows.note: Use this for sluggish, slow-moving behavior, especially when the action takes a long time.

example.english: They indolently ate breakfast and ended up late for work.
example.traditional: 佢慢吞吞咁食早餐，搞到返工遲到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 tan1 tan1 gam3 sik6 zou2 caan1 gaau2 dou3 faan1 gung1 ci4 dou3
